celebrate:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production transparent 2D desktop companion animation sheet.
Input roles:
IMAGE 1 is the SINGLE MASTER of character appearance: the actual idle sprite. Its exact face, clothing, ornaments, proportions and brush rendering are authoritative.
IMAGE 2 is the EDIT TARGET: a 1536x1024 transparent 6-column x 4-row sheet containing 24 copies of that exact idle sprite. Animate THIS girl by changing only the required limb/body poses and expressions.
IMAGE 3 is ONLY a gesture/timing guide from the old animation. Its face, head size, clothes, hair accessories, red/pink saturation and drawing style are WRONG. Do not copy its artwork or identity. Transfer gestures only.
Primary request: redraw this action so switching from idle does not look like a costume, head ornament, face or art-style change. Match image 1 far more closely than image 3. Keep the source idle's exact head-to-body ratio and face/eye size in all 24 drawings.
Identity/style lock: same front-facing girl, warm brown eyes and soft closed-mouth smile geometry; exact ivory lace bonnet silhouette with the same two small white bunny ornaments, strawberries/flowers at their original sides, and small pastel barrettes; same center bangs, long softly wavy chocolate-brown hair, two thin front braids and small pink bows. Exact SAME pale ivory dress, cream bow at the chest, same neckline/sleeve ruffles, pink accents and strawberry placement, same number and order of lace/frill skirt tiers; white ruffled socks and cream strawberry Mary Jane shoes. Do not turn the dress redder, change its cut, add bigger ribbons, turn shoes into red boots, add jewelry, enlarge bunnies or simplify lace. Preserve the idle's soft hand-painted 2D illustration, fine warm brown linework, muted cream/pink palette, matte shading and restrained highlights. No shiny 3D/plastic rendering, no sharper/darker outlines, no different anime face.
Output exactly ONE PNG with genuine transparent RGBA alpha, 1536x1024 pixels, SIX equal columns by FOUR equal rows; exactly 24 square 256x256 cells, one complete girl in each, reading order. No labels/grid/numbers. No background, matte, floor, shadows, gradients or baked checkerboard. Keep all opaque pixels 6+ px inside each cell. Each neutral figure stays centered at local x=128 with shoe soles at local y=244; neutral bonnet top approximately y=31. Match image 2's framing, body size and neutral alignment, and keep the whole body in frame. Continuous animation poses, no random camera zoom or head inflation. Hair and skirt may move gently with the action but the construction and accessories stay identical.
Blink must be bilateral and progressive, with just one fully closed drawing between partial closures and reopenings; no wink. Do not freeze one open-mouth face for the whole sheet. Do not interpolate ghost images or double limbs.
Action: gentle delighted CLAPPING. 24 consecutive hand-drawn poses. Frames 1-3 start from the idle stance and closed-mouth smile; frames 4-7 smoothly lift bent forearms to chest height, palms face each other. Frames 8-16 perform three small clear clap contact-and-separation beats, shoulders relaxed and elbows near the body; hands approach, touch, separate, not a waving pose. Frame 8 both eyes 75% open; 9 both 25% open; 10 fully closed; 11 both 25% open; 12 both 75% open; 13 onwards reopen. A gentle happy smile evolves during claps. Frames 17-22 slowly lower hands, 23-24 return EXACTLY to the image-1 idle neutral stance and small smile. Feet remain planted at y=244, head and bonnet mostly steady; small secondary hair/skirt motion only. First and last neutral artwork should match image 1 almost pixel-for-pixel.
